assumptions: Existing Supabase backend and Hono API remain operational
Apple Developer and Google Play Console accounts are active
Discord bot is already deployed and accessible
Audio canticle files are hosted on accessible CDN URLs
risks: ChapterReader is 52KB — most complex component to port, may need 2 sprints
react-native-track-player has platform-specific quirks for background audio
Text selection for highlights is limited in React Native — may need custom native module
Expo SDK 53 compatibility with all chosen libraries must be verified
App Store review may flag meditation content as health claims
Offline sync conflict edge cases may surface post-launch

sprints.name: Project Setup & Foundation

sprints.name: Local Database & Sync Engine

sprints.name: Achievements, Streaks & Discord
sprints.focus: Achievement gallery, streak tracking, Discord bot integration, push notifications

sprints.name: Testing & QA
sprints.focus: Unit tests, integration tests, E2E with Maestro, performance audit

sprints.name: CI/CD, Deployment & Store Submission
sprints.focus: EAS Build, GitHub Actions, store submission, OTA updates
